messages:
Maya P: FYI: Scheduled fallback-capacity experiment in eu-west-1 nights of 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-12, 23:30-02:30 UTC. Purpose: validate graceful-deg routing + KV prefill under low load and measure p99 delta. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/euw1-fallback-experiment
Ethan L: Quick: what's the traffic ramp plan and max percent? Which pools?
Maya P: Plan: 1) 2% canary for 15m 2) 10% for 30m 3) 20% steady (max 20%). Pools: euw1-primary, euw1-fallback, euw1-kv-prefill. Experiment id: exp-euw1-20260510.
Tony (oncall): Oncall watching /slo/fallback-euw1. Abort criteria: p99 > 1.6x baseline for 10m OR errors > 1.5% sustained 5m. If abort: controller rollback + 10m observation.
Sam R: We'll add an experiment tag to metrics and create a temporary SLO advisory in Console (no SLA change). Support bulletin prepared for Dedicated customers.
ops-bot: Job scheduled: exp-euw1-20260510 at 2026-05-10T23:30:00Z. Logs -> #eng-sre-experiments.
deploy-bot: Deploy freeze enforced for euw1 pools 23:00-03:00 UTC on nights of the experiment.
Tony (oncall): Oncall checklist: 1) watch p99 & error-rate 2) validate kv.prefill.hit 3) confirm traffic shift percent in controller logs 4) run abort if thresholds hit.
Maya P: Abort command:
```
POST https://controller.internal/api/v1/experiments/exp-euw1-20260510/abort
Authorization: Bearer <oncall-token>
```
After abort: wait 10m then confirm green.
Ethan L: I'll dry-run the controller flow in staging today.
Maya P: Post-run: daily AM summary in this thread, then a review meeting Tue 2026-05-13 15:00 UTC to review telemetry and decide next steps. Please avoid non-urgent deploys to euw1 during windows.
Tony (oncall): Acknowledged. Ping me @Tony for immediate action.
